mods.name: 按键精灵社区版（Keyboard Wizard CE）
mods.description: Keyboard Wizard CE is a community-maintained port that makes finding and fixing key bind conflicts easier.

releases.notes:
## Keyboard Wizard CE v1.0.0 - NeoForge 26.3

### 支持版本
- Minecraft: 26.3
- NeoForge: 26.3.0.23-beta+
- Java: 25

### 主要特性
- 键盘可视化配置界面
- 三个分区支持：主键盘区、数字键盘区、辅助功能区
- 鼠标按键配置支持
- 冲突按键高亮显示
- 一键重置所有按键绑定

### API更新
- 更新到Minecraft 26.3正式版API
- 使用InputConstants.Type.KEYBOARD替代Type.KEYSYM
- 使用isKeyDown(int)新API
- 使用setScreenAndShow新屏幕API
- 移除LWJGL GLFW直接依赖

### 文件信息
- keyboard-wizard-ce-neoforge-26.3-1.0.0.jar (241KB) - Mod主文件
- keyboard-wizard-ce-neoforge-26.3-1.0.0-sources.jar (190KB) - 源码文件

### 安装方法
1. 确保已安装Minecraft 26.3和NeoForge 26.3.0.23-beta或更高版本
2. 将jar文件放入mods文件夹
3. 启动游戏，在控制设置中找到"键盘向导"按钮

### 注意事项
- 本版本基于NeoForge 26.3.0.23-beta构建，兼容所有26.3+版本的NeoForge加载器
- 暂不支持帮助按钮和搜索过滤功能（这些功能在Fabric版本中可用）

# Keyboard Wizard CE Forge 1.20.1 v1.0.2beta

## Changes Since v1.0.1

- Added optional Hide Key Binding compatibility.
- Keyboard Wizard CE now hides bindings that Hide Key Binding hides when the companion mod is installed.
- The integration is optional: Hide Key Binding is not a required dependency, and CE keeps normal behavior when it is absent.
- Hidden bindings are skipped by the list, categories, keyboard tooltip/search, conflict/unbound statistics, and reset/clear actions.

Full history: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/wu-xiao-ya/Keyboard-Wizard-CE/blob/ce/forge-1.20.1/CHANGELOG.md)

# Keyboard Wizard CE NeoForge 1.21.1 v1.0.1

## Changes Since v1.0.0

- Added key-based filtering: middle-click a key in the Keyboard Wizard CE screen to show all bindings assigned to that key.
- Added mod/category labels to the key binding list so similar binding names from different mods are easier to distinguish.
- Added an in-screen help tooltip for the key search interaction.
- Updated the mod icon, art credit, metadata, and CE version to 1.0.1.

Full history: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/wu-xiao-ya/Keyboard-Wizard-CE/blob/ce/neoforge-1.21.1/CHANGELOG.md)
